title: Converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 character encoding and ignoring invalid characters, in the GNU C Library…
description: A vulnerability in the GNU C Library (glibc) version 2.1 or later involves converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 with the //IGNORE flag set. This can cause the iconv converter to read past the end of the input buffer, leading to a crash of the calling application. The issue arises when an invalid CP949 byte sequence causes the decoder to advance the read pointer incorrectly at the buffer's end.
